import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": ["s0", "s1", "s2", "s3"]},
]
def mkdoc(transitions, requires=None):
    modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
                "requires": requires}]
    machine = {"states": ["s0", "s1", "s2", "s3"], "initial": "s0", "state_param": "state",
               "message_param": "msg", "transitions": transitions}
    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["entry"],
            "machine": machine, "runs": []}

# harness: state -> x0 (enum, w4); msg -> x1 buffer, x2 x3 x4 x5 chars; r -> x6
def run_case(doc, state_index, msg, result=0):
    objs = [obj("x0", state_index, 4)]
    for i in range(4):
        objs.append(obj("x%d" % (2 + i), ord(msg[i]) if i < len(msg) else 0, 1))
    objs.append(obj("x6", result, 1))
    doc["runs"] = [{"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)}]
    return run(doc)

TR = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "c", "cost": 2, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "x", "cost": 1, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "hi")
print(json.dumps(g["corpus"]))
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "x", "hi"], g["corpus"]
assert g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 2
assert g["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"
print("PASS cost then lexicographic minimisation")

# initial state needs no preparation
g = run_case(doc, 0, "go")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["go"] and g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 0, g["corpus"]
print("PASS initial state")

# unreachable
g = run_case(doc, 3, "hi")
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "UNREACHABLE"}, g["records"]
assert g["corpus"] == []
print("PASS unreachable")

# guard evaluated on recovered inputs, including desired state
TR2 = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1,
   "when": ["eq", ["var", "state"], ["const", "State", "s2"]]},   # only enabled when desired is s2
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "x", "cost": 1, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR2)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "hi")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "x", "hi"], g["corpus"]
g = run_case(doc, 1, "hi")
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "UNREACHABLE"}, g["records"]
print("PASS guard uses recovered desired state")

# guards on the message
TR3 = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": ["match", ["var", "msg"], "[0-9]*"]},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "x", "cost": 1, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR3)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "77")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "x", "77"], g["corpus"]
g = run_case(doc, 2, "no")
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "UNREACHABLE"}, g["records"]
print("PASS guard on message")

# cost beats count: (cost 3, 1 cmd) vs (cost 2, 2 cmds)
TR4 = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s2", "command": "z", "cost": 3, "when": None},
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR4)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "m")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "b", "m"] and g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 2, g["corpus"]
print("PASS cost dominates command count")

# count beats lexicographic: (cost 2, 1 cmd "z") vs (cost 2, 2 cmds "a","b")
TR5 = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s2", "command": "z", "cost": 2, "when": None},
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR5)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "m")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["z", "m"] and g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 2, g["corpus"]
print("PASS command count dominates lexicographic order")

# lexicographic among equal (cost, count): a,b vs b,a
TR6 = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s3", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s3", "to": "s2", "command": "y", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "z", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "c", "cost": 1, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR6)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "m")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "y", "m"], g["corpus"]
print("PASS lexicographic command sequence")

# cycles: revisit states
TR7 = [
  {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s0", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None},
  {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "c", "cost": 5, "when": None},
]
doc = mkdoc(TR7)
g = run_case(doc, 2, "m")
assert g["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "c", "m"] and g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 6, g["corpus"]
print("PASS cycles handled")

# long path: chain of 500 states
states = ["q%d" % i for i in range(501)]
tr = [{"from": "q%d" % i, "to": "q%d" % (i + 1), "command": "c%d" % (i % 7), "cost": 1, "when": None}
      for i in range(500)]
types2 = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": states},
]
modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]
machine = {"states": states, "initial": "q0", "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg", "transitions": tr}
doc = {"types": types2, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["entry"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
objs = [obj("x0", 500, 4), obj("x2", ord('m'), 1), obj("x3", 0, 1), obj("x5" if False else "x4", 0, 1), obj("x6" if False else "x5", 0, 1), obj("x6", 0, 1)]
doc["runs"] = [{"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)}]
import time
t = time.time()
g = run(doc)
assert g["corpus"][0]["cost"] == 500 and len(g["corpus"][0]["commands"]) == 501, g["corpus"][:1]
print("PASS long chain in %.3fs" % (time.time() - t))
PYEOF
